title: Lennard-Jones 38 clusters

reducer.failure: L2 norm of the force above force_norm, or total_force_calls >= max_force_calls
reducer.force_calls: half-even mean of total_force_calls on the runs that are not failures

sota_requires: The code commit is the one named in codes/registry.toml.
The geometries are this sha256, all of them.
The stop is this convergence block, not a per-atom force and not a step cap added after the first pass.
The build identity is recorded on the result.
